en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town nestled in a valley surrounded by hills. In the foreground, a man in traditional attire and a child stand in a grassy field. The town features several church towers, traditional European-style buildings, and a small white structure with a fence. The background is dominated by rolling hills and mountains. The caption at the bottom reads 'Feldkirchen (Kärnten).'
